description: This script performs a preflight check to verify that Java 21+ is available in the environment. It checks specific environment variables (JAVA_TOOLCHAIN_JAVA21_HOME, JAVA_21_HOME, JAVA_HOME) and the default java command in PATH to ensure they point to Java 21+ installations. The script exits with an error if any Java version found is below 21, facilitating CI/build environment validation.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: parse_major_version
methods.description: Parses the Java major version number from the output of 'java -version' string.

methods.name: check_env_home
methods.description: Checks a specified environment variable for its Java installation, verifies it's executable, and confirms the Java version is >= 21.

methods.name: check_path_java
methods.description: Checks the 'java' command available in PATH, verifies its version, and confirms it's Java 21+.
